title: Agentic Power BI Squad
summary: A multi-agent system of GitHub Copilot agents and skill files that generates complete Power BI (PBIP) projects — semantic models, DAX measures, mock data, and reports — from functional specifications. Its mock-data-generation skill documents an optional SDV pattern (GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, HMASynthesizer, SingleTableMetadata/MultiTableMetadata) that a Copilot agent can invoke to synthesize referentially-consistent CSV star-schema datasets, falling back to deterministic generation if SDV is absent.
evidence: .github/skills/mock-data-generation/SKILL.md:122-159 shows sdv.metadata/sdv.single_table imports and GaussianCopulaSynthesizer/HMASynthesizer usage patterns for AI-agent-driven mock data generation
needs: SDV is explicitly optional/fallback per requirements.txt comments; unclear if the skill's code pattern is ever actually executed versus only offered as agent guidance.
